title: Canonical ordinary signed-twist Hom site comparison
statement: Fix the finite datum $P$ and the ordinary signed-twist Hom groups $H^a(X,A(r))$ on the small etale and pro-etale sites of [def-pur-supported-class-operations]. For a scheme $X$ and integers $a,r$, define the ordinary comparison $H^a(X_{\mathrm{et}},A(r))\to H^a(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A(r))$ by exact derived comparison inverse image, precomposed with the inverse degree-zero constant-coefficient identification and followed by the canonical shift and defining twist identification. These are the ordinary counterparts of the supported comparison in [def-pur-supported-hom-site-comparison], with the same coefficient and shift conventions. This names the map only, with no bijectivity or compatibility assertion.

source.place: Tag 099W, lemma-compare-cohomology; Tag 09B1, lemma-compare-derived. The ordinary degree-zero and shift comparison is functorialCupOrdinaryCompare in SupportedCupFunctoriality.
